labels.edge:e2: Website to shop API: HTTPS, session cookie
labels.edge:e3: shop API to shop.db: orders, outbox rows
labels.edge:e4: shop API to PayLane: charges card
labels.edge:e5: send_emails to shop.db: reads unsent outbox
labels.edge:e7: shop API to shop.db: export request row
labels.edge:e8: build_exports to shop.db: reads orders, writes outbox row
labels.edge:e9: build_exports to Export files: uploads CSV (Netlify deploy API)
labels.edge:e10: Customer to Export files: downloads CSV from emailed link
labels.step:order/s1: Website to shop API: POST /v1/orders (Flows, step 1)
labels.step:order/s2: shop API to PayLane: charge card (Flows, step 2)
labels.step:order/s3: PayLane to shop API: charge id (Flows, step 3)
labels.step:order/s4: shop API to shop.db: save order + outbox row, one transaction (Flows, step 4)
labels.step:order/s5: shop API to Website: 201 order id (Flows, step 5)
labels.step:order/s6: send_emails to shop.db: read unsent outbox rows (Flows, step 6)
labels.step:export/x1: Website to shop API: POST /v1/account/export (session cookie) (Flows, step 1)
labels.step:export/x2: shop API to shop.db: insert exports row (pending) (Flows, step 2)
labels.step:export/x3: shop API to Website: 202 Accepted (Flows, step 3)
labels.step:export/x4: build_exports to shop.db: read pending exports, the customer's orders (Flows, step 4)
labels.step:export/x5: build_exports to Export files: upload /exports/<random token>.csv (Flows, step 5)
labels.step:export/x6: build_exports to shop.db: outbox row: email with download link (Flows, step 6)
labels.step:export/x7: send_emails to shop.db: read outbox, send link email (Flows, step 7)
labels.step:export/x8: Customer to Export files: GET /exports/<token>.csv (no login) (Flows, step 8)
